hadiths.arabicText: سَحْنُونٌ، عن عَلِيِّ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عن سُفْيَانَ، عن أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عن عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عن عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ: "لَيْسَ الْوِتْرُ بِحَتْمٍ كَالْمَكْتُوبَةِ، وَلَكِنَّهَا سُنَّةٌ سَنَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ"
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ali ibn Abi Talib: Witr is not obligatory like the prescribed prayers, but it is a Sunnah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ established.

narrators.name: سحنون
narrators.full_name: عبد السلام بن سعيد بن حبيب التنوخي المعروف بسحنون

narrators.name: علي بن زياد
narrators.full_name: علي بن زياد بن يزيد التونسي

narrators.name: سفيان
narrators.full_name: سفيان بن سعيد بن مسروق الثوري
reliabilityIssues: Known for minor tadlis but generally reliable

narrators.name: أبو إسحاق
narrators.full_name: عمرو بن عبد الله بن عبيد السبيعي الهمداني

narrators.name: علي بن أبي طالب
narrators.full_name: علي بن أبي طالب بن عبد المطلب القرشي الهاشمي

chainIssues: Abu Ishaq experienced ikhtilat though Sufyan al-Thawri was an early narrator from him

plainChains: سحنون -> علي بن زياد -> سفيان الثوري -> أبو إسحاق -> عاصم بن ضمرة -> علي بن أبي طالب

potential_issues.issue: Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i experienced ikhtilat (memory confusion) in his later life
potential_issues.impact: However, Sufyan al-Thawri was among the early narrators from Abu Ishaq, so this is likely from before the ikhtilat. Minor concern only.

potential_issues.issue: Sufyan al-Thawri is known for minor tadlis and uses 'an here
potential_issues.impact: Minimal impact as Sufyan is highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt) and his tadlis is minor (category 2). His narrations from Abu Ishaq are particularly strong.

potential_issues.issue: Statement is mawquf (stopped at Ali), not marfu' to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: This is Ali's statement attributing the Sunnah to the Prophet ﷺ indirectly, not a direct prophetic narration.

Topics: Witr Prayer Status
Distinction between Obligatory and Sunnah Prayers
Statement of Ali ibn Abi Talib about Witr

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عن ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عن خَالِدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونَ الصَّفَدِيِّ، عن الْحَسَنِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَوِتْرٌ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ: أَوْتِرْ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by al-Hasan: A man said: 'O Messenger of Allah, should I pray Witr after Fajr?' So he said to him on the third time: 'Pray Witr.'

narrators.name: ابن وهب
narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي الفهري المصري

narrators.name: ابن لهيعة
narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن لهيعة بن عقبة الحضرمي المصري
reliabilityIssues: Weak due to his books being burned
More reliable when narrating through Ibn Wahb

chainIssues: Mursal from al-Hasan al-Basri who did not meet the Prophet ﷺ

plainChains: ابن وهب -> ابن لهيعة -> خالد بن ميمون -> الحسن البصري -> Prophet ﷺ (mursal)

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Lahi'ah is a weak narrator whose books were burned
potential_issues.impact: Significant weakness, though narrations through Ibn Wahb are slightly better.

potential_issues.issue: Khalid ibn Maymun al-Safadi is majhul al-hal

potential_issues.impact: Critical weakness. Al-Hasan did not meet the Prophet ﷺ. His mursal reports are among the weakest.

Topics: Witr Prayer Timing
Question about Praying Witr after Fajr

hadiths.arabicText: مَا جَاءَ فِي قَضَاءِ الصَّلَاةِ إِذَا نَسِيَهَا
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What has come regarding making up a prayer when one forgets it
Topics: Chapter Heading about Making Up Forgotten Prayers

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ: وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ: مَنْ ذَكَرَ صَلَاةً نَسِيَهَا وَهُوَ فِي صَلَاةِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ، قَالَ: إِنْ كَانَ وَحْدَهُ فَذَكَرَهَا حِينَ افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ، فَلْيَقْطَعْ وَلْيُصَلِّ الَّتِي نَسِيَ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ الَّتِي كَانَ فِيهَا
hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: Whoever remembers a prayer he forgot while he is in an obligatory prayer - if he is praying alone and he remembers it when he begins the prayer, then let him stop and pray the one he forgot, then pray this one he was in.
Topics: Fiqh Ruling on Remembering Forgotten Prayer During Current Prayer
Malik's Legal Opinion on Prayer Order

hadiths.arabicText: فِيمَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَهَا فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding one who forgets a prayer, then remembers it during the time of another prayer
Topics: Chapter Heading about Remembering Forgotten Prayer During Another Prayer Time

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ: وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ: مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً أَوْ صَلَاتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَهُنَّ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ، قَالَ: إِذَا كَانَتْ يَسِيرَةً صَلَّاهُنَّ قَبْلَ الصُّبْحِ، وَإِنْ فَاتَ وَقْتُ الصُّبْحِ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ صَلَوَاتٍ كَثِيرَةً بَدَأَ بِالصُّبْحِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى مَا كَانَ نَسِيَ
hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: Whoever forgets one, two, or three prayers, then remembers them before Subh prayer - if they are few, he should pray them before Subh, even if the time of Subh passes. But if they are many prayers, he should begin with Subh, then pray what he had forgotten.
Topics: Fiqh Ruling on Multiple Forgotten Prayers
Priority of Current Prayer versus Missed Prayers

hadiths.arabicText: فِيمَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً فَذَكَرَهَا فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِهَا
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding one who forgets a prayer and remembers it at the end of its time
Topics: Chapter Heading about Remembering Prayer at End of Its Time

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ: وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى الصُّبْحَ وَالظُّهْرَ فَلَا يَذْكُرُهُمَا إِلَّا فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ، قَالَ: يَبْدَأُ بِالصُّبْحِ، وَإِنْ خَرَجَ وَقْتُ الظُّهْرِ
hadiths.english_translation: Malik said regarding a man who forgets Subh and Dhuhr and does not remember them except at the end of Dhuhr time: He should begin with Subh, even if the time of Dhuhr passes.
Topics: Fiqh Ruling on Prayer Order
Priority of Earlier Missed Prayer

hadiths.arabicText: فِي إِمَامٍ ذَكَرَ صَلَاةً نَسِيَهَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding an imam who remembers a forgotten prayer while in prayer
Topics: Chapter Heading about Imam Remembering Forgotten Prayer

hadiths.arabicText: وَقَالَ فِي إِمَامٍ ذَكَرَ صَلَاةً نَسِيَهَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ. قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ مَالِكٌ: أَرَى أَنْ يَقْطَعَ وَيُعْلِمُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُوا
hadiths.english_translation: Ibn al-Qasim said: Malik said regarding an imam who remembers a forgotten prayer while in prayer: I see that he should stop and inform them, and they should stop.
Topics: Fiqh Ruling on Imam Remembering Forgotten Prayer
Congregation Prayer Procedure

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عن زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: إِذَا رَقَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ عن الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ نَسِيَهَا، ثُمَّ فَزِعَ إِلَيْهَا فَلْيُصَلِّهَا كَمَا كَانَ يُصَلِّيهَا إِذَا صَلَّاهَا لِوَقْتِهَا
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Zayd ibn Aslam: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When one of you oversleeps a prayer or forgets it, then rushes to it, let him pray it as he would pray it at its proper time.'

narrators.name: مالك بن أنس
narrators.full_name: مالك بن أنس بن مالك بن أبي عامر الأصبحي

narrators.name: زيد بن أسلم
narrators.full_name: زيد بن أسلم العدوي العمري المدني
reliabilityIssues: This is mursal - Zayd did not meet the Prophet ﷺ

chainIssues: Zayd ibn Aslam did not meet the Prophet ﷺ

plainChains: مالك بن أنس -> زيد بن أسلم -> Prophet ﷺ (mursal)

potential_issues.issue: This is a mursal hadith - Zayd ibn Aslam was from the Tabi'in and did not meet the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Missing link in the chain. However, Malik's mursal reports from Zayd ibn Aslam are generally considered strong among mursal narrations, and Zayd is thiqah.
Confirms the mursal nature of the narration.

Topics: Method of Making Up Forgotten Prayers
Praying Missed Prayer Like Its Original Time

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ مَالِكٌ، عن ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عن ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً فَلْيُصَلِّهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: وَأَقِمُ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Ibn al-Musayyib: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, for indeed Allah says: And establish prayer for My remembrance.'

narrators.name: مالك
narrators.full_name: مالك بن أنس بن مالك بن أبي عامر الأصبحي

narrators.name: ابن شهاب
narrators.full_name: محمد بن مسلم بن عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن شهاب الزهري
reliabilityIssues: Classified as mudallis by some scholars though highly reliable

narrators.name: ابن المسيب
narrators.full_name: سعيد بن المسيب بن حزن القرشي المخزومي
reliabilityIssues: Mursal - did not meet the Prophet ﷺ except possibly as a very young child

chainIssues: Ibn Shihab uses 'an and is classified as mudallis though reliable

plainChains: مالك -> ابن شهاب الزهري -> سعيد بن المسيب -> Prophet ﷺ (mursal)

potential_issues.issue: Mursal from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib who was born during the caliphate of Umar and did not have extensive contact with the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Missing link in the chain, though Ibn al-Musayyib's mursal reports are considered among the strongest mursal narrations.

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri uses 'an and is classified as mudallis (category 3) by some scholars
potential_issues.impact: Minor concern as al-Zuhri is extremely reliable (Thiqah Thabt) and widely accepted. His narrations are generally accepted even with 'an.

Topics: Obligation to Make Up Forgotten Prayers
Quranic Evidence for Making Up Prayers
Time for Making Up Missed Prayer

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عن مَالِكٍ، عن نَافِعٍ، عن ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً فَلَمْ يَذْكُرْهَا إِلَّا وَهُوَ وَرَاءَ الْإِمَامِ، فَإِنْ سَلَّمَ الْإِمَامُ فَلْيُصَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي نَسِيَهَا، ثُمَّ لِيُصَلِّ بَعْدَهَا الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي كَانَ فِيهَا مَعَ الْإِمَامِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Ibn Umar, he said: 'Whoever forgets a prayer and does not remember it except while behind the imam - when the imam gives salam, let him pray the prayer he forgot, then pray after it the prayer he was in with the imam.'

narrators.name: ابن وهب
narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي الفهري المصري

narrators.name: مالك
narrators.full_name: مالك بن أنس بن مالك بن أبي عامر الأصبحي

narrators.name: نافع
narrators.full_name: نافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر العدوي المدني

narrators.name: ابن عمر
narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب القرشي العدوي

plainChains: ابن وهب -> مالك -> نافع -> ابن عمر

potential_issues.issue: This is the famous golden chain (Malik -> Nafi' -> Ibn Umar) which is considered one of the strongest chains in hadith literature
potential_issues.impact: Extremely strong chain. However, this is mawquf (stopped at Ibn Umar) not marfu' (elevated to the Prophet ﷺ).
Not a concern given the extremely high reliability of all narrators and their well-documented meetings.

Topics: Ibn Umar's Ruling on Remembering Forgotten Prayer Behind Imam
Procedure for Missed Prayer During Congregation

hadiths.arabicText: مَا جَاءَ فِي السَّهْوِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What has come regarding forgetfulness in prayer
Topics: Chapter Heading about Forgetfulness in Prayer

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ: وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ: لَوْ أَنَّ إِمَامًا صَلَّى بِقَوْمٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَسَلَّمَ فَسَبَّحُوا بِهِ فَلَمْ يَفْقَهْ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مَعَهُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ إِنَّكَ لَمْ تُتِمَّ فَأَتِمَّ صَلَاتَكَ
hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: If an imam prays two rak'ahs with people and gives salam, and they glorify Allah to alert him but he does not understand, then a man from behind him who is with him in prayer says to him 'You have not completed, so complete your prayer'...
Topics: Fiqh Ruling on Imam Making Error in Prayer
Alerting Imam to Mistake
Speaking During Prayer to Correct Imam
